mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that suppresses economic growth and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, which triggers a market correction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an impending slowdown in the housing sector, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates a tight labor market that fuels inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high consumer spending (RSAFS > 680,000) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1600) indicates a shift in consumer demand away from housing, which may signal an economic slowdown and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 680000 and HOUST < 1600, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.
